headline: Junior UX/UI Designer
summary: Creative and user-focused UX/UI Designer with a background in Computing from Islington College. Passionate about creating seamless digital experiences through user research, iterative prototyping, and aesthetic visual design. Experienced in collaborating within agile teams during internships at leading Nepal-based tech firms and executing end-to-end design for academic and freelance projects.

experiences.title: UX/UI Design Intern
description: Assisted senior designers in creating high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes for local e-commerce applications.
Conducted usability testing sessions with 10+ participants to identify pain points in user flows.
Collaborated with the front-end development team to ensure design hand-offs were pixel-perfect using Figma.
Updated the internal design system library with new components and icons.

experiences.title: Lead UI Designer
description: Designed a safety-focused ride-sharing mobile application concept for women in the Kathmandu Valley.
Performed extensive competitor analysis of existing apps like Pathao and Indriver to identify feature gaps.
Developed a comprehensive design system including typography, color palette, and custom UI elements.
Built a fully interactive prototype that was presented to a panel of industry experts at Islington College.

experiences.title: UI Designer
description: Revamped the landing page for a local handicraft startup based in Bhaktapur to improve conversion rates.
Simplified the checkout process, reducing the number of steps from five to three.
Ensured 100% mobile responsiveness across various device screen sizes.
